reader_summary.headline: Dylan is the co-founder and CEO of Figma and last joined me on Invest Like the Best in 2020.
reader_summary.overview: Dylan is the co-founder and CEO of Figma and last joined me on Invest Like the Best in 2020. A lot has changed since then and we explore the evolving landscape of design and how Figma has been navigating AI while staying true to its founding vision of eliminating the gap between imagination and reality..

key_points.text: A lot has changed since then and we explore the evolving landscape of design and how Figma has been navigating AI while staying true to its founding vision of eliminating the gap between imagination and reality..
Despite Figma's incredible success in becoming the default design platform, Dylan remains deeply motivated by helping users achieve their goals.
He shares fascinating insights about the underhyped aspects of AI reasoning capabilities, the future of design literacy.
